column1: # aggressive fusion leg a (dot habu-automatic-aggressive-fusion): LAYERNORM SCALE BIAS = ROW-REDUCE->EW->EW through the AUTOMATIC pipeline, fused 1 block-per-row kernel vs ablated 3 kernels; both device==host golden PASS (1 vs 3 regions); fused wins 1.41x - the affine scale+bias fold into the layernorm reduction epilogue at ~zero marginal cost (fused 214.3 vs ablated layernorm-alone 213.5 ms), eliminating 2 standalone flat-EW global round-trips (43.4+45.6 ms); the block-per-row reduction dominates (1.07 ms/launch), so the win is bounded below the 3x equal-cost-op model (maki/layernorm-fusion-bench-device-test.f)
